# Release Upload Recovery

[Source plan](./plan.md)

### R-REL-09

The release command must preserve completed release steps after an upload failure. The accepted [HX-DEF-01](./design.md#human-experience-intent) resume outcome remains owed through [O-HX-001](./obligation.md).
